messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2: [INC-2026-4123] cuda_illegal_memory_access detected on serving-runtime-3 (eu-west-1). ~30% pod crash rate, automatic restarts. Triggered at 2026-04-05T10:21:08Z
oncall-mike: Ack. Paging in. Looking.
eng-runtime-anna: Checking logs, grabbing kernel traces and nvcrash dumps. Any recent rollouts?
ops-bot: Deploy note: runtime-serving v6.2.1 rolled to eu-west-1 ~9m ago by deploy-bot.
eng-runtime-anna: Good — reproducing locally. Initial signal looks like kv-cache index/offset corruption when seq length spikes.
sre-miguel: Immediate mitigation plan: cordon affected nodes, drain one at a time, scale up warm spare pool (+2), and add routing rule to prefer fallback pool. I'll start cordon now.
oncall-mike: Cordoned nodes: serving-runtime-3-12, serving-runtime-3-13. Draining 12 now. Posting status as I go.
cust-success-liz: FYI two customers (Acme Analytics, BrightForms) reported ~5% request failures and higher tails. Sending brief to their CSMs now, ETA ~30m for next update.
eng-runtime-anna: Quick crash snippet from pod crashlog: ```RuntimeError: CUDA illegal memory access at 0x7f9c2f8a...
  at serve::kv_cache::read+0x1f4
  at serve::attention::compute+0x3b0``` Looks like kv-cache index overflow on some inputs.
devex-kate: Can we temporarily enable prefix-caching and route long-seq traffic to the quantized-4bit variant to reduce GPU memory pressure?
sre-miguel: Applied routing rule to push ~40% of traffic to fallback pool. Canary metrics show error rate dropped 30%->6% in 3m. Scaling spare pool now.
oncall-mike: Drain complete for node 12. Rebooting container runtime on 12 to clear GPU state, then will uncordon if stable. Node 13 draining.
eng-runtime-anna: Repro + root cause: regression introduced in v6.2.1 around kv-cache bounds checking. Hotfix plan: rollback eu-west-1 to v6.2.0, then ship v6.2.2 with bounds checks. Rolling rollback started.
incident-bot: Incident update: severity -> SEV-3 (customer impact reducing).
oncall-mike: Rollback 6.2.1 -> 6.2.0 in progress (eu-west-1). ETA ~18m.
cust-success-liz: Notified affected customers with mitigation steps and fallback details. Will follow up with timeline and postmortem link once stable.
oncall-elaine: Taking over handoff (1hr). Current state: rollback ~60% done, aggregated error rate ~2.1%, cordoned nodes 12/13, spare pool scaled +2. I'll monitor overnight. @sre-miguel please append runbook notes.
sre-miguel: Runbook notes uploaded: - If error rate >5% re-escalate to SEV-2. - Steps executed: cordon/drain, rollback runtime, enable fallback routing, scale spare pool. - Artifacts to collect: nvcrash, kernel dmesg, perf traces, pod logs. Logs uploaded to /incident/INC-2026-4123.
ops-bot: Auto-ticket update: INC-2026-4123 status=stabilizing owner=@oncall-elaine
oncall-elaine: Acknowledged, taking ownership. Handoff complete. Monitoring and will post updates if anything regresses. Signing off from day shift.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for incident coordination: CUDA illegal memory access, kv-cache offset glitch, drain/rollback/fallback routing, customer comms and on-call handoff.
